# Rosemary Esthetics

> Licensed esthetician studio in Idaho Falls, Idaho, owned by Jillian Easter. Customized facials, dermaplaning, lash lifts and tints, brow lamination, facial waxing, back treatments, and LED light therapy (new). Tagline: "love the skin you're in."

## Business facts
- Owner: Jillian Easter, Licensed Esthetician (Idaho), Austin Kade Academy graduate
- Address: 1096 S Boulevard, Idaho Falls, ID 83402
- Phone (call or text): (208) 521-0938
- Email: jillianeaster05@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon & Thu 9am-6pm; Wed 3pm-8pm; Fri 9am-2pm; Sat 9am-9pm; closed Sun & Tue
- Closed July 31 - August 2, 2026
- Booking: online via Square at https://rosemary-esthetics-100073.square.site/s/appointments (20% deposit, applied to service)
- Payments: cash, Venmo, credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible entrance, restroom, and parking; free lot and street parking; gender-neutral restroom; LGBTQ+ friendly
- Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/rosemaryesthetics | TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@rosemaryesthetics | Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61574276690955

## Services and pricing
- Facials: Signature Facial $80 (1h15); Smooth + Glow Facial (Dermaplane) $90 (1h30); Skin Reset Facial $40 (35m); Couples Facial $90 (1h)
- Lashes: Eyelash Lift $35 (30m); Eyelash Lift and Tint $55 (45m); Eyelash Tint $20 (30m)
- Brows: Eyebrow Lamination $25 (40m); Eyebrow Lamination and Tint $40 (45m); Brow Tint $15 (20m); Eyebrow and Eyelash Package $85 (1h15)
- Waxing: Full Face $30; Eyebrow Shape/Wax $20; Lip $8; Chin $8; Underarm $20
- Back: Heated Stone Back Treatment $85 (1h); Back Reset Treatment $75 (1h)
- Add-ons: Gua Sha Sculpting $5; LED Light Therapy (new) $10

## Policies
- 20% deposit to book (applies to service). Cancel/reschedule with 24+ hours notice.
- Late-cancel fees: under 24h = 50%, same day = 75%, no-show = 100%.
- Under 18 welcome with parent/guardian consent. Cannot treat active wounds, sunburn, contagious skin conditions, cold sores, or irritated skin.
